summary.key_theme: Cloudflare 憑藉 AI 爬蟲控制功能與統一平台策略獲得市場關注，但近期股價在強勁漲勢後出現獲利回吐壓力。

bullish.title: Do Cloudflare’s (NET) New AI Crawler Controls Quietly Strengthen Its Data-Moat Narrative?

bullish.title: Can Unified Platform Strategy Boost Cloudflare's Long-Term Growth?
bullish.reason: 統一平台策略成功吸引大型企業客戶，透過整合安全、網路與開發工具，展現強勁的長期成長潛力。

bullish.title: Muse-Apocalypse: 5 Stocks To Buy For The Agentic AI Era

bearish.title: Cloudflare (NET) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
bearish.reason: 股價在近期強勁上漲後出現 3.2% 的回調，反映出投資人進行獲利了結的壓力。

bearish.title: What Happens To Cloudflare Stock If Its Growth Cools?
bearish.reason: 股價在三個月內上漲約 61% 並接近三年高點，市場開始擔憂若成長速度放緩，高估值將面臨修正風險。

bearish.title: Underweight Position in Cloudflare (NET) Creates Relative Headwind

neutral.title: Is It Worth Investing in Cloudflare (NET) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
neutral.reason: 華爾街平均建議維持買入，但市場對於過度樂觀的預期與當前高估值之間存在分歧。

neutral.title: Here's How Much $100 Invested In Cloudflare 5 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
